goal: Evaluate Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on AISHELL-1 (zh) and LibriSpeech test-clean (en) using the existing MCP server harness.
execution_steps: generate_predictions_via_server with bounded smoke test (first dataset, 10 samples)
generate_predictions_via_server for all selected datasets (full run)
stop_condition: Evaluation completes for all selected datasets with valid metrics, or smoke test fails, or anomaly metrics detected (>50% WER/CER or <20% accuracy).
notes: Resume is enabled by default (--resume) for prediction generation.
Dataset language context must be preserved: aishell1=zh, librispeech_clean=en.
GPU preflight required per EXECUTION_READINESS_UNIT contract.
If smoke test fails, stop and handoff to tool workflow rather than patching wrapper.
